stances_toward.note: The patron relation that Abu Dhabi denies: UN experts and a Le Monde investigation describe Emirati supply by air through Chad and eastern Libya (RFI: about 600 flights to Koufra in 2025), Reuters describes the Kufra airstrip as the RSF's conduit, and the foreign ministry calls the claims 'baseless'. Graded partner (transactional, no alignment, no declared support) with confidence C because the deniable nature of the tie leaves only reporting; the Egyptian and Saudi side reads it as an Emirati client. Bond none: gold, ports and an anti-Islamist calculation, not identity.

stances_toward.note: The RSF is the rival, not a mortal enemy of the Egyptian state: Cairo backs the army, is reported to have struck RSF-linked convoys (9 Jan 2026) and pressed Haftar to cut the RSF supply line through Kufra, but has not declared an aim to destroy the RSF and takes part in a Quad that includes the RSF's alleged patron. No source gives the grade word; confidence C (our reading of reported actions, some single-sourced).
